description: Ops Copilot golden eval set (#123 Phase D). One case = question, the tool sequence a competent operator expects, and the answer shape that makes the answer usable. The CI suite replays each case through the real graph with the deterministic provider (proving registry, schemas, execution, budgets, guardrails); the scheduled live run (ml/evals/run_copilot_eval.py via the copilot_evals DAG) serves the same cases to the configured provider and scores its ACTUAL tool selection and answer shapes into the copilot_evals MLflow experiment. Bump version when cases change; a CI regression on this file fails the build like any other test.
